title: % members with open coding gaps
one_line_definition: The percentage of attributed members who have at least one open coding gap — a condition that should be coded but has not yet been documented.
numerator_meaning: The count of members who have one or more open coding gaps, regardless of flag status.
denominator_meaning: The total number of attributed members.
result_meaning: The share of the member population with at least one condition that should be coded but remains unaddressed, indicating the breadth of coding gap exposure across the panel.

measure_meanings.% members with open coding gaps: The proportion of total attributed members who have at least one open coding gap, expressed as a percentage.
measure_meanings.% Members with open coding gaps YoY Card: Displays the year-over-year percentage change in the share of members with open coding gaps, formatted as an upward or downward arrow with the percentage difference from the same period last year.
